# Configuration

<!-- Generated by `identity-service env --markdown` (mise run docs:config). Do not edit by hand. -->

identity-service reads its configuration from environment variables. Outside development the connection strings, URLs and secrets are required; missing ones fail startup with an explicit list. Invalid values fail startup with a non-zero exit code. An empty value counts as absent for text variables (the default applies) and as invalid for numbers, durations and booleans.

Variables are declared once, as tags on `config.Config` (`internal/config/config.go`), and parsed by cleanenv; the rules tags cannot express (required outside development, minimum secret lengths, distinct listen addresses) live next to them in `validate`.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required outside development | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LISTEN_ADDR` | text | `:8080` |  | Public zone: sign-in, provisioning, GraphQL, probes |
| `INTERNAL_LISTEN_ADDR` | text | `:8081` |  | Internal zone: session validation for ext-auth, metrics, e2e login; must differ from LISTEN_ADDR |
| `APP_ENV` | text | `development` |  | One of development, staging, production; must be set explicitly inside Kubernetes |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | log level | `info` |  | One of debug, info, warn, error |
| `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` | duration, e.g. 30s or 24h | `10s` |  | Grace period for in-flight requests on shutdown |
| `DATABASE_URL` | text | `postgres://identity:identity@localhost:5433/identity_development?sslmode=disable` (development only) | yes | PostgreSQL connection string (development: compose DB on localhost:5433) |
| `REDIS_URL` | text | `redis://localhost:6380/0` (development only) | yes | Redis connection string for sessions (development: localhost:6380) |
| `BASE_URL` | text | `http://localhost:8080` (development only) | yes | Public base URL of this service (development: http://localhost:8080) |
| `FRONTEND_BASE_URL` | text | `http://localhost:8080` (development only) | yes | Where the browser lands after login (development: http://localhost:8080) |
| `SAML_IDP_METADATA_URL` | text | — | yes | Okta IdP metadata URL; SSO routes are not mounted without it |
| `SAML_ALLOW_IDP_INITIATED` | true or false | `false` |  | Accept SAML responses without InResponseTo (IdP-initiated sign-in) |
| `RELAY_STATE_SECRET` | text | `insecure placeholder, rejected outside development` (development only) | yes | HMAC secret for the RelayState token; outside development at least 32 characters and not the development default |
| `SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` | text | `__identity_session` |  | Session cookie name |
| `SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT` | duration, e.g. 30s or 24h | `24h` |  | Session idle expiry, slides with activity |
| `SESSION_LIFETIME` | duration, e.g. 30s or 24h | `720h` |  | Absolute session lifetime |
| `SESSIONS_MAX_CONCURRENT` | integer | `100` |  | Per-user session cap; oldest sessions are evicted |
| `USER_REVOCATION_DELAY` | duration, e.g. 30s or 24h | `60s` |  | Max staleness of the user active-flag cache |
| `PERMISSIONS_CACHE_TTL` | duration, e.g. 30s or 24h | `60s` |  | Max staleness of effective permissions (revocation delay) |
| `CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES` | integer | `10000` |  | Capacity of each hot-path cache; least recently used entries are evicted |
| `SCIM_TOKEN` | text | — |  | Bearer token for the Okta SCIM client, at least 32 characters; SCIM is disabled without it |
| `RABBITMQ_URL` | text | `amqp://identity:identity@localhost:5673/` (development only) | yes | RabbitMQ connection string for user events (development: localhost:5673) |
| `EVENTS_EXCHANGE` | text | `identity.events` |  | Topic exchange for user-change events |
| `OUTBOX_RETENTION` | duration, e.g. 30s or 24h | `720h` |  | How long published events stay in the outbox before being trimmed |
| `SENTRY_DSN` | text | — |  | Error-reporting DSN; Sentry is disabled without it |
| `E2E_LOGIN_TOKEN` | text | — |  | Bearer token for programmatic test sessions, at least 32 characters; rejected in production |
